answer: A workable design charges newcomers upfront and refunds on merit. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the wander of free entry disappears, the falcon of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the grove case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
